verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a native export of project data to open formats. The only related evidence is indirect: Python editor scripting can build asset pipelines that connect Unreal to other 3D applications, and plugins can add new file types, so a user could script or build their own exporters. Cooking converts content into platform-specific formats rather than open ones. Missing for 10: a documented built-in export of assets and levels to open, standard formats, any statement on project or asset format openness, and hands-on evidence of a successful full-project migration out of Unreal.
